title: refactor: extract runtime-UI datasource-admin out of open repo
body:
## What

Extracts the **runtime UI-created datasource lifecycle** (ADR-0015 Addendum: list / test / create / update / remove datasources defined in the UI) out of the open-source framework. The code now lives in the **private** \`@objectstack/datasource-admin\` package (cloud monorepo).

**Federation stays open** — ADR-0015 main body (introspect / draft / import / validate of external tables) remains in \`@objectstack/service-external-datasource\` + the federation REST routes + \`ExternalValidationPlugin\`.

## Two orthogonal axes

- **Axis A — \`origin\`**: \`code\` (\`*.datasource.ts\`, GitOps, read-only) vs \`runtime\` (UI-created, editable, in \`sys_metadata\`). *This axis is what moved out.*
- **Axis B — \`schemaMode\`**: \`managed\` vs \`external\`/federation. *Stays open.*

The open \`DatasourceSchema\` keeps its inert \`origin\` field + \`allowRuntimeCreate: true\` flag (zero-cost skeleton) so the private package layers on without a core patch.

## Changes

- **spec**: drop \`datasource-admin-service\` + \`datasource-driver-factory\` contracts (+ barrel exports)
- **runtime**: drop \`default-datasource-driver-factory\` + \`datasource-secret-binder\` (+ host-glue exports)
- **service-external-datasource**: drop \`DatasourceAdminService\`(+Plugin); keep \`ExternalDatasourceService\`(+Plugin)
- **rest**: \`external-datasource-routes\` keeps federation routes only; \`rest-api-plugin\` registers only \`registerExternalDatasourceRoutes\`
- **cli/serve**: drop \`DatasourceAdminServicePlugin\` wiring; keep federation + Gate 2 (\`ExternalValidationPlugin\`)

## Verification

Open repo green post-extraction: spec build clean · service-external-datasource 22 tests · runtime 320 tests · rest 78 tests · cli tsc clean. Straggler grep finds only NOTE comments — zero code references to moved symbols.
